scope: Two-repeat 10-second selected KV9 versus Redis WAIT1/WAIT2 point/batch64 writes; all three servers counted. No equal durability, continuous replica health, sustained capacity or full-history claim.
rate_aggregation: Sum successful calls/items divided by sum cohort elapsed time; two opposite target orders
latency_aggregation: Merged successful whole-call raw histograms; percentiles are bucket bounds, not averaged quantiles
cpu_scope: Recomputed from first/last in-window proc process user+system ticks and each process monotonic sample duration; 100 ticks/s on the same captured boot. Three server rates summed; endpoint gaps <=150 ms, no substage attribution.
